neighbours.label: The tokens ' hamburg' and ' clock' (an early-layer pole with several unrelated strong tokens)
fire: We grilled hamburgers in the yard on Sunday.
The old station clock stopped at noon.
My cousin ordered two hamburgers and a milkshake.
She glanced at the kitchen clock and ran for the bus.
The stand by the lake sells hamburgers all summer.
Each processor cycle is driven by the system clock signal.
He flipped the hamburgers while the corn roasted.
The tower clock chimes every quarter of an hour.

She glanced at the kitchen window and ran for the bus.
The stand by the lake sells ice cream all summer.
Each processor cycle is driven by the system power signal.
He flipped the pancakes while the corn roasted.
The tower bell chimes every quarter of an hour.
